title: Gruyere + WebGoat gap analysis: systematic coverage matrix and missing capability identification
goal: Add Google Gruyere and OWASP WebGoat as official benchmark targets in the AegisPT test lab. Run AegisPT against both apps (local instances), record which of the 52 total vulnerabilities are detected vs. missed, and produce a coverage scorecard. This scorecard drives tooling priorities. Gruyere covers: XSS (6 variants), CSRF, XSSI, Path Traversal (2 variants), Client-State Manipulation, CSRF, Remote Code Execution, SQL Injection, DoS (3 variants), Config Disclosure, AJAX Phishing, Buffer Overflow — 20 total. WebGoat covers: Auth Bypass, Bypass Restrictions, Client-Side Filtering, CSRF, Insecure Deserialization, Session Hijacking, HTML Tampering, IDOR, Insecure Login, JWT vulnerabilities, Missing Access Controls, Open Redirect, Password Reset flaws, Path Traversal, Security Misconfiguration, Cookie Spoofing, SQL Injection (classic + advanced + blind), SSRF, Vulnerable Components, XSS (reflected + stored + DOM), XXE, Cryptography, Insufficient Logging — 32 total. Implementation: (1) Add docker-compose entries for local Gruyere and WebGoat instances in the test lab. (2) Create an assessment pack for each target covering all applicable tools at passive + active tier. (3) Run and record: which findings were created, severity, tool that found it. (4) Produce a coverage_report.json: vulnerability_id, expected_detection, actual_detection, tool_used, notes. (5) Any vulnerability with actual_detection=false becomes a gap task.
scope: Strategic gap analysis 2026-05-03: compared AegisPT's 33-tool arsenal against Google Gruyere (20 vulnerabilities) and OWASP WebGoat (32 vulnerabilities). Estimated current coverage: Gruyere ~45%, WebGoat ~38%. This is a systematic benchmark run to confirm and document the gap precisely.
generation_reason: Systematic comparison against Gruyere and WebGoat confirms significant detection gaps — benchmark run produces the exact priority list for tooling improvements.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only run existing tools against lab targets. Do not implement new detection capabilities in this task — that is the job of the gap tasks that follow.

coverage_report.json produced with expected vs actual detection per vulnerability.
